exposure: Postpartum day 1 systolic blood pressure levels
outcome: Postpartum readmission due to severe hypertension
cohort: 4,317 women with pregnancy-associated hypertension diagnosed before initial discharge from January 2009 to December 2016
finding: Non-Hispanic Black women with pregnancy-associated hypertension before initial discharge had increased odds of postpartum readmission due to hypertension compared to non-Hispanic White women.
